en: This is a vintage postcard showing a black-and-white photograph of a waterfront scene, likely from an early 20th-century Swedish town. The view features a river or coastal area with wooden docks, logs floating in the water, modest houses on the shoreline, and forested hills in the background. The address side contains Swedish handwriting, a green Swedish stamp with 'SVERIGE' and a portrait, and a postmark from 'SUNDSVALL.' The text 'BRÉFKORT (CARTE POSTALE)' appears at the top, reinforcing its use as a postcard.
